title: Piccolissima
author: Adélaïde de Montgolfier
longDescription: Follen is a charming story in the tradition of children's literature, likely written in the mid-19th century.

authorInfo.bio: Adélaïde de Montgolfier (1789–1880) wrote Piccolissima. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
